Server/loadgen CPU and RSS cover process lifetime before evidence output, including setup; loadgen also includes input preparation. Dividing server CPU by measured completions is an amortized cost, not a request-only CPU window. Server source binding records CMake provenance and source hashes, not reproducible-build attestation. Shared loadgen/verifier are separately bound by their own binary hashes and build records.
